_why.TIME_WARP_GAMMA: 1.5 slows the pm rush (3:42 to 5:25 per eighth) and cuts midnight to 5 am to 3.3 s without a faster peak rate
_why.CARD_LINES: line 1 opens unlike the buses video before it (line 2) and the GTA trains after it (line 0)
_why.ROUTE_ALPHA: 0.5 draws the GO lines as green lines between their few trains; at the large-frame 0.2 they vanish and GO reads as loose dots
_why.ROUTE_WIDTH: 2.4 px keeps the dormant GO and subway lines visible at phone size next to the trails
_why.TRAIL_ALPHA: 0.7, the small-frame value: about 170 trains never fuse, and the large-frame 0.35 left the subway as dotted rows
_why.TRAIL_CORE_W: 5 px cores make each subway line one solid stroke in its own colour (Line 1 gold, Line 2 green, Line 5 orange)
_why.TRAIL_SHOULDER_W: 16 px glow sets the subway lines apart from the dark street grid without merging Lines 1 and 2 downtown
_why.TRAIL_LAYER_ALPHA: 1 keeps the line colours at full strength; 0.65 was for the 2,900-vehicle all-modes map
_why.day.TRAIL_MINUTES: 25 min trails join GO trains on 15 to 30 minute headways into lines; at 12 they are single dots
_why.frame: 80 km: the subway and LRT lines fill the band and GO runs off the edges; the fitted 119.5 km left them a third
